I now have a complete picture. Here is my report.

## Overview

"Owner identity" is currently a **version 1 / flat** shape: `memberId`, `householdId`, and `identityKey` are top-level fields on the `Owner` response schema, there is **no `apiVersion` field**, and the audit event has **no `schemaVersion`**. The `AcceptanceTest` already encodes the intended v2 target (nested `identity` object + `apiVersion: 2`), so it is currently failing/aspirational. `OwnerDto` is **generated at build time** from `openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/...` — there is no `OwnerDto.java` in the source tree, so the response shape is defined entirely in the OpenAPI spec.

---

## 1. Region code derivation

Region is derived from city and/or postcode by three pinned lookup tables plus a `Locality` combinator.

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CityRegion.java` — city→region (`Sydney`→`NSW`, `Melbourne`→`VIC`, `Brisbane`→`QLD`, else `UNKNOWN`); `of(city)` and `isKnown(region)`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/RegionPostcodes.java` — region→inclusive postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); `allows(region, postcode)` and `regionOf(postcode)`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Locality.java` — `of(city, postcode)`: prefers postcode (`RegionPostcodes.regionOf`), falls back to `CityRegion.of(city)`; never null (yields `UNKNOWN`).

This "region code" is the `REGION` segment embedded in the `memberId` (see below).

---

## 2. `householdId`, `identityKey`, `memberId` computation

**memberId** — format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/MemberId.java` — `of(region, registrationDate, normalizedTelephone, lastName)` builds `region + FY(2-digit) + Sha256.prefix(tel+lastName, 8) + CheckDigit`. Also `dedupe(candidate, existing)` (appends `-<n>`) and `regionOf(memberId)` (extracts REGION by stripping the fixed 11-char tail `FY+HASH8+CHK`, after removing any `-<n>` suffix).
- Assigned by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java` — computes `region = Locality.of(city, postcode)` then `owner.setMemberId(MemberId.of(...))`.
- Uniqueness enforced by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/DeduplicateMemberId.java` — collects existing memberIds, calls `MemberId.dedupe`.

**householdId** — first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 of `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdNormalizer.java` — `id(lastName, postcode)`, `key(...)`, `belongsTo(owner, householdId)`; name normalization lower-cases + collapses whitespace.
- Stamped by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`.
- Consumed by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CountHousehold.java` (household size).

**identityKey** — note there are **two divergent definitions** (a likely wrinkle to be aware of when planning):
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKey.java` — `forOwner(owner)` / `of(telephone, email, lastName)` returns `Sha256.hex(normTel + "|" + normEmail + "|" + Soundex.of(lastName))` — i.e. a single opaque SHA-256 hash over telephone, email, and last-name Soundex. Used by `EnsureUniqueIdentity` (duplicate block) and `FlagPossibleDuplicate`.
- However the OpenAPI description and `OwnerMapper.identityKey` Javadoc describe it as "canonical telephone, email and household id joined by '|'" — the **doc text is stale** relative to the actual `IdentityKey` implementation (which uses Soundex, not householdId, and hashes the whole thing). Worth confirming which is intended for v2.

Supporting helpers: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256.java`, `.../util/CheckDigit.java`, `.../util/FiscalYear.java`, `.../util/Soundex.java`.

---

## 3. Owner response shape / DTO

The DTO is generated from `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (openapi-generator, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, package `...rest.dto`; pom.xml lines ~369-424). The `Owner` schema (`allOf: OwnerFields + object`) is at **openapi.yml lines ~2119-2277+**. Relevant fields, all currently **top-level** and `readOnly`:
- `locality` (line 2160) — region from city.
- `timezone` (2168) — IANA tz from locality.
- `memberId` (2177) — `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`; description explicitly says "Replaces the former customerCode, checkDigit and membershipNumber."
- `fiscalYear` (2190), `householdId` (2200), `identityKey` (2210), `telephoneDisplay` (2220), `namesakeCount` (2229), `membershipPoints` (2240), `membershipLevel` (2252), `ownerSegment` (2264, enum PREMIUM_METRO/PREMIUM_REGIONAL/STANDARD_METRO/STANDARD_REGIONAL), `bulkSignupWarning`, `capacityWarning`, `contactPreference`, plus more below line 2300.

The mapping from entity → DTO is `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (MapStruct). Key derived getters: `locality(owner)` (prefers `MemberId.regionOf(memberId)`, falls back to `Locality.of`), `timezone`, `ownerSegment`, `identityKey` (delegates to `IdentityKey.forOwner`), `memberId` mapped directly from the entity field.

Response wiring: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java`, `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java`, `RespondWithExistingOwner.java`.

**No `apiVersion` field exists** anywhere in `openapi.yml`. The only "version" strings in the spec are ETag header descriptions ("An ID for this version of the response") and the `/v2/owners` endpoint (owner-v2 tag) — but that v2 is purely about **pagination** (`OwnerPage`), not identity grouping. So the nested `identity` object and `apiVersion` the tests expect are not yet implemented.

Persisted entity fields: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `memberId` (col `member_id`), `householdId` (col `household_id`); `identityKey`, `locality`, `timezone`, `ownerSegment` are **not stored**, they are derived at response time.

---

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When present it
            prefixes the 'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are
            preferred and this field is returned as their normalized composition (the normalized
            'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when non-blank and normalized the same way. Optional, for backward
            compatibility with the flat 'address' form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's
            region via the pinned region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. A household is keyed on last name and postcode, so a
            second owner with the same last name and postcode is otherwise rejected
            as a conflict. When true, the create request is allowed and the owner is
            recorded as a declared household member (and never flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, formatted as the honorific 'title' followed by a single
                space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality (region) via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for a region with no timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN'), the two-digit fiscal
                year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration date, the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with
                the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Replaces the former customerCode, checkDigit and
                membershipNumber.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically. Assigned to every owner at creation.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived, opaque summary of the owner's contact identity: the canonical
                telephone, the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and the household id,
                joined by '|'. Surfaces the parts for at-a-glance comparison; duplicate
                detection itself keys off the household id (same last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then
                the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Zero when the
                name was new.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score that starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email
                address is present, 1 when the owner has a unique name (namesakeCount is zero), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when at least one fiscal year (starting
                1 July) has elapsed since the owner's registration date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from 'membershipPoints':
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more. Because a newly
                created owner has zero tenure, a new owner never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's 'locality' is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the moment it was created;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment it was created, i.e. approaching the hard capacity limit of 50;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their details: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' measured against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an existing
                owner's last name and postcode while giving a different telephone number; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one is a possible duplicate of (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), fixed at creation. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single follow-up signal, true when any of the owner's individual risk
                markers hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the
                owner's city was over its soft capacity at creation ('capacityWarning'), or
                the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a registrable label
                with a known disposable-mail provider without being one). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, and the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The details of the new pet.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When present it
            prefixes the 'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are
            preferred and this field is returned as their normalized composition (the normalized
            'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when non-blank and normalized the same way. Optional, for backward
            compatibility with the flat 'address' form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's
            region via the pinned region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. A household is keyed on last name and postcode, so a
            second owner with the same last name and postcode is otherwise rejected
            as a conflict. When true, the create request is allowed and the owner is
            recorded as a declared household member (and never flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, formatted as the honorific 'title' followed by a single
                space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality (region) via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for a region with no timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: the unified memberId, the householdId and the derived
                identityKey grouped together. Each identifier mixes in a fixed version tag, so the
                values differ from the version-1 identifiers even for the same owner details.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically. Assigned to every owner at creation.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived, opaque summary of the owner's contact identity: the canonical
                telephone, the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and the household id,
                joined by '|'. Surfaces the parts for at-a-glance comparison; duplicate
                detection itself keys off the household id (same last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then
                the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Zero when the
                name was new.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score that starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email
                address is present, 1 when the owner has a unique name (namesakeCount is zero), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when at least one fiscal year (starting
                1 July) has elapsed since the owner's registration date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from 'membershipPoints':
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more. Because a newly
                created owner has zero tenure, a new owner never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's 'locality' is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the moment it was created;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment it was created, i.e. approaching the hard capacity limit of 50;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their details: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' measured against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an existing
                owner's last name and postcode while giving a different telephone number; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one is a possible duplicate of (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), fixed at creation. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single follow-up signal, true when any of the owner's individual risk
                markers hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the
                owner's city was over its soft capacity at creation ('capacityWarning'), or
                the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a registrable label
                with a known disposable-mail provider without being one). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, and the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

      type: object
