      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When present it
            prefixes the 'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are
            preferred and this field is returned as their normalized composition (the normalized
            'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when non-blank and normalized the same way. Optional, for backward
            compatibility with the flat 'address' form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's
            region via the pinned region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. A household is keyed on last name and postcode, so a
            second owner with the same last name and postcode is otherwise rejected
            as a conflict. When true, the create request is allowed and the owner is
            recorded as a declared household member (and never flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, formatted as the honorific 'title' followed by a single
                space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality (region) via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for a region with no timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: the unified memberId, the householdId and the derived
                identityKey grouped together. Each identifier mixes in a fixed version tag, so the
                values differ from the version-1 identifiers even for the same owner details.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then
                the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Zero when the
                name was new.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score that starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email
                address is present, 1 when the owner has a unique name (namesakeCount is zero), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when at least one fiscal year (starting
                1 July) has elapsed since the owner's registration date.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from 'membershipPoints':
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more. Because a newly
                created owner has zero tenure, a new owner never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's 'locality' is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the moment it was created;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment it was created, i.e. approaching the hard capacity limit of 50;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their details: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' measured against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an existing
                owner's last name and postcode while giving a different telephone number; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one is a possible duplicate of (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), fixed at creation. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single follow-up signal, true when any of the owner's individual risk
                markers hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate'), the
                owner's city was over its soft capacity at creation ('capacityWarning'), or
                the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a registrable label
                with a known disposable-mail provider without being one). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, and the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer

          minimum: 0

        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

        - totalElements

    PetFields:

lines: +                The version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the owner's identifiers under
+                a nested 'identity' object and derives them with the version-2 identity algorithm.

content.text: Now add the `OwnerIdentity` schema definition, right before the `Owner` schema:

input.old_string:
Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
input.new_string:
OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together. Every value mixes in a fixed version tag,
        so it differs from the version-1 identifier for the same owner details.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the version-2 region
            code (the region — Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN' — with the
            version tag mixed in), the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-
            adjusted registration date, the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
            normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit
            computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Replaces the former customerCode,
            checkDigit and membershipNumber.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex characters
            of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name, the postcode and the version tag. Owners with
            the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned to every owner at creation.
          type: string
          example: '3F9A1C2B4D5E'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            A derived, opaque token summarising the owner's contact identity: the SHA-256 hex of the
            canonical telephone, the lower-cased email (empty when absent), the Soundex of the last
            name and the version tag, joined by '|'. A read-only summary for at-a-glance comparison;
            duplicate detection keys off it directly.
          type: string
          example: '9f2c1a7b3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When present it
            prefixes the 'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are
            preferred and this field is returned as their normalized composition (the normalized
            'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when non-blank and normalized the same way. Optional, for backward
            compatibility with the flat 'address' form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's
            region via the pinned region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. A household is keyed on last name and postcode, so a
            second owner with the same last name and postcode is otherwise rejected
            as a conflict. When true, the create request is allowed and the owner is
            recorded as a declared household member (and never flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner representation. Version 2 groups the owner's identifiers under
                a nested 'identity' object and derives them with the version-2 identity algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-

              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone

                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for a region with no timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity

                on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-

                the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678').

              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true

content.text:
All 10 tests pass and the build succeeds. The audit log line confirms the new behavior end-to-end:

```
{"schemaVersion":2,"seq":1,"ownerId":11,"memberId":"NSWV22716E6609E7","membershipLevel":1,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}
```

Note the member id embeds region code `NSWV2` (the plain region `NSW` + the `V2` tag), while `locality` continues to report the plain `NSW`.

## What I changed

**New — `util/IdentityVersion.java`**: the single home for the version-2 identity release. Holds `VERSION = 2`, the fixed `TAG` (`"V2"`), and the three mixing helpers: `regionCode(plain)` (tags the region embedded in the member id), `plainRegion(code)` (recovers the bare region back), and `tagged(input)` (prefixes the tag into a hash input).

**Identity derivation (every identifier now changes, and no v1 value recurs):**
- `AssignMemberId` — passes `IdentityVersion.regionCode(...)` as the member-id region, so `NSW` → `NSWV2`.
- `HouseholdNormalizer.id` — hashes `IdentityVersion.tagged(key(...))`.
- `IdentityKey.of` — hashes `IdentityVersion.tagged(...)`.

**Keeping the user-facing region plain:**
- `OwnerMapper.locality` — un-tags via `IdentityVersion.plainRegion(MemberId.regionOf(...))`, so `locality`, `timezone`, and the owner segment all recompute from the version-2 member id yet keep reporting the bare region code (`NSW`). `MemberId` itself stays a pure formatter, unaware of versioning.

**Response shape:**
- `openapi.yml` — new `OwnerIdentity` schema; the `Owner` schema now nests `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey` under `identity`, drops them from the top level, and adds a top-level integer `apiVersion`.
- `OwnerMapper` — new `identity(owner)` builds the nested `OwnerIdentityDto` (reusing `IdentityKey.forOwner`), and `apiVersion()` returns `IdentityVersion.VERSION`.

**Audit schema:**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` — adds a local `SCHEMA_VERSION = 2` constant, emitted as `schemaVersion` in the JSON. (Left the audit event's own schema version independent of the identity-algorithm constant, since they're conceptually distinct version numbers that merely coincide at 2.)

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) are untouched.

- `openapi.yml` — new `OwnerIdentity` schema; the `Owner` schema now nests `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey` under `identity`, drops them from the top level, and adds a top-level integer `apiVersion`.
- `OwnerMapper` — new `identity(owner)` builds the nested `OwnerIdentityDto` (reusing `IdentityKey.forOwner`), and `apiVersion()` returns `IdentityVersion.VERSION`.

**Audit schema:**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` — adds a local `SCHEMA_VERSION = 2` constant, emitted as `schemaVersion` in the JSON. (Left the audit event's own schema version independent of the identity-algorithm constant, since they're conceptually distinct version numbers that merely coincide at 2.)

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) are untouched.
